answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works through bonded, gradual identity. Each agent locks a refundable bond and earns an opal-tier credential only after proving sustained, unique work across epochs. A zephyr-fast random audit each round samples identities and flags those that share payers or move in lockstep; clusters that look hollow—no independent history, cloned patterns—get slashed. An attacker must post a fresh bond per fake agent and still risk correlation detection, so thousands of empty identities carry real capital loss. The mechanism makes fakery expensive per head.
